Compact WSON/VSON/SOT-563 packages demand tight hot-loop layout and thermal vias.

For boost/switch-limited converters, usable Iout ≈ Isw × (Vin / Vout) × η minus half ripple ΔIL/2.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 3 (FB vs NC), Pin 4 (EN vs VOUT), Pin 5 (VIN vs NC). Soldering TPS613221ADBVR onto a TPS61040DBVR footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.

CRITICAL RECTIFICATION LAYOUT DIFFERENCE: TPS61040DBVR is non-synchronous and requires an external Schottky catch/freewheeling diode footprint near SW, whereas the counterpart integrates a synchronous low-side MOSFET.

CRITICAL FEEDBACK LAYOUT DIFFERENCE: One converter is fixed-output while the other is adjustable; adding or removing the external R1/R2 feedback divider and feedforward capacitor requires a PCB layout change.

HIGH SWITCHING FREQUENCY SHIFT: fsw differs by 38% (TPS61040DBVR: 1000 kHz p.1 vs TPS613221ADBVR: 1600 kHz p.9); re-evaluate inductor core loss, ripple current ΔIL, output capacitor ESR ripple, and EMI harmonics.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (TPS61040DBVR: 10 µH p.4 vs TPS613221ADBVR: 2.2 µH p.4); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: TPS61040DBVR specifies 400 mA (switch current limit Isw, p.5) vs TPS613221ADBVR 1200 mA (switch current limit Isw, p.5). Remember boost/switch-limited Iout,max is strictly less than Isw due to duty-cycle and inductor ripple scaling.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: TPS61040DBVR requires Vin,min >= 1.8 V (p.4) vs 0.9 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (TPS61040DBVR: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to 85°C TA, TJ max 125°C) vs TPS613221ADBVR: -40..125 °C Industrial / Extended (-40°C to 125°C TJ)); TPS61040DBVR hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: TPS61040DBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) and TPS613221ADBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 3 (FB vs NC), Pin 4 (EN vs VOUT), Pin 5 (VIN vs NC); synchronous vs non-synchronous rectification mismatch (external Schottky footprint); fixed vs adjustable output feedback footprint mismatch (R1/R2 divider). Specific pin conflicts: Pin 3 (FB vs NC), Pin 4 (EN vs VOUT), Pin 5 (VIN vs NC). Power-stage deltas: boost (non-sync) vs boost (sync), switching frequency 1000 kHz (p.1) vs 1600 kHz (p.9) (1.6x ratio), typical inductor 10 µH (p.4) vs 2.2 µH (p.4), output mode adjustable vs fixed, and package θJA 205.2 vs 189.7 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: TPS61040DBVR "VIN Capped at 6.0 V (7.0 V Abs Max) vs Pin-Compatible 14 V LM27313/LM2733" (p.4) and TPS613221ADBVR "No Enable (EN) Pin and No True Load Disconnect" (p.3). BOM decision: Choose TPS61040DBVR when matching your existing Texas Instruments SOT-23-5 (DBV) qualification and -40..85 °C grade; choose TPS613221ADBVR when you want synchronous rectification without an external Schottky diode or higher switch current capacity (1200 mA) is required. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
